subject: Request: Staged off-ramp + conditional credit authorization for Novexa Health
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara@novexa.com>, Novexa Procurement <procure@novexa.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Staged off-ramp + conditional credit request (Novexa)

Team —

Following this morning’s call with Novexa, they’re asking for two non-standard items to close: a softened ramp schedule and an early-termination credit bucket that protects them if clinical timelines slip. High-level asks from Novexa:
- Move from a 6-month hard ramp to a 3+3 staged ramp (50% committed month 1-3, then scale to 100% month 4-6),
- Option to opt out within the first 90 days with a pro-rated credit up to $40k (applied against remaining committed fees),
- One-time 10% onboarding discount tied to signing within 7 business days.

I’ve attached the proposed SOW and the revised ramp spreadsheet Novexa shared. Finance flagged that the credit bucket and opt-out language are non-standard and need executive sign-off from Revenue/Deal Desk.

Can we get an approval or a clear counter (we need something to take back in tomorrow’s EMEA sync)? If approved, Novexa requires the amendment to be DocuSigned and attached to the master SOW.

Thanks —
Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara@novexa.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged off-ramp + conditional credit request (Novexa)

+1 to escalation. I like a compromise path:
- Approve staged ramp as proposed (3+3).
- Approve a conditional credit bucket but narrow scope: credit only against committed fees for months 4-6 and capped at 40k OR 50% of remaining committed ARR, whichever is lower.
- Require 30-day termination notice to trigger the credit, and customer must provide usage reports for the 30-day lookback so we can validate.

We should also tie the onboarding discount to a signed amendment (no retroactive). If Markus can confirm the legal/finance safe caps we can escalate to Marissa for an exec exception. Novexa is sensitive to timeline; they want terms in DocuSign by next Friday.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Director, Sales Operations
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara@novexa.com>, Novexa Procurement <procure@novexa.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged off-ramp + conditional credit request (Novexa)

Logan / Soojin —

I’m comfortable with the staged ramp and a conditional credit bucket provided we add the following guardrails:
1) Credit calculation: credit = min(40,000 USD, 50% * remaining committed value) and applied only to months 4-6 committed fees (no credits on usage overages).
2) Trigger mechanics: Customer must give 30 days written notice; credit is only payable after a 30-day validation period during which we reconcile usage against the commitment.
3) Documentation: Must be an amendment (DocuSign) that explicitly lists the ramp schedule, credit calculation, and termination trigger. No backdating.
4) Timebox: This concession is a one-time exception tied to this signature; do not use as precedent without Deal Desk note.

If Marissa signs off on these constraints, we should be able to give Novexa the amended SOW with the ramp_schedule.xlsx attached. I’ll add a clause in the amendment language that limits cumulative credit exposure by calendar year to prevent risk stacking.

Markus Klein
VP, Revenue Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara@novexa.com>, Novexa Procurement <procure@novexa.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 14:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged off-ramp + conditional credit request (Novexa) — APPROVED (conditional)

Thanks for the clear summary. I approve the concession with Markus’ guardrails and the following additional conditions:
- Cap overall one-time customer exposure at 40k USD (hard cap).
- Require ProcureOps sign-off and a single DocuSign amendment that includes the ramp table, credit calc, termination mechanics, and an explicit non-precedent clause.
- Legal to add a clause preventing credit stacking with any other promotional discounts.
- If Novexa requests additional flexibility after signing, escalate back to me.

Logan: proceed to draft the amendment (use Markus’ template), attach SOW_Novexa_v2.pdf and Novexa_ramp_schedule.xlsx, and route to ProcureOps + Legal for the DocuSign package. Tell Novexa we can have the amendment ready within 3 business days once we receive final signatures.

Marissa Cole
SVP, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
